prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Houston for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right choice depends on your location, age, treatment goals (metal braces vs clear braces vs Invisalign), budget/insurance, and personal preferences. I can, however, help you find top options and tell you how to pick the best doctor for you.

Quick steps to find a top Houston orthodontist
- Tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether this is for a child or adult, and whether you prefer Invisalign or traditional braces. I can then list highly rated local specialists and compare them.
- Look for these credentials and features:
  - Board certification (American Board of Orthodontics, ABO) — indicates advanced testing and high standards.
  - Membership in the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO).
  - Experience with Invisalign (some offices are “Elite” or “Premier” providers; that’s a plus for complex clear-aligner cases).
  - Before/after photos of cases similar to yours and patient reviews.
  - Modern technology (digital scans like iTero, 3D imaging) — helps with accuracy and comfort.
  - Clear pricing, payment plans, and good communication.
- Ask these questions at a consultation:
  - Are you board-certified?
  - What treatment options do you suggest for my case, and why?
  - How many Invisalign/aligner cases have you completed?
  - Estimated treatment length and total cost (including retainers and follow-ups).
  - Do you accept my insurance or offer financing?
  - Can I see before/after photos of cases like mine and speak to references?

Places to search and verify
- Invisalign Provider Locator (on Invisalign’s website) for nearby doctors with verified Invisalign experience.
- AAO.org to find orthodontists in your area.
- Check Google, Yelp and Healthgrades for recent patient reviews and photos.
- Look up “American Board of Orthodontics” to verify board certification.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code (or general area of Houston) and whether this is for a child or adult and I’ll pull together a short list of highly rated orthodontists near you, including notes on ABO certification, Invisalign experience, estimated cost ranges, and how soon you could get a consult.
